description: This file defines a React Button component with customizable styles and behaviors, including utility functions for styling variants, and exports the component for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: getColorsForNormalVariant
methods.description: Returns background and text color classes based on the ButtonStyle for normal (non-primary) buttons.

methods.name: getColorsForPrimaryVariant
methods.description: Returns background and text color classes based on the ButtonStyle for primary buttons.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Generates the CSS class string for the Button component based on its properties like type, style, disabled state, and layout options.
